cross_checks.twins: A430 G0A independent oracle rule (research/rounds A430 twins conflict evidence G0A verifier)

twins.valid_vote: kind=='vote' and round==candidate_round and received<=decision_time and author in validator_set
twins.support: authors whose valid votes include candidate_block
twins.C: any supporter has a valid vote for a block != candidate_block
twins.action: reject_conflict if C else accept if Q else wait

lanl.S: distinct KNOWN failed destination computers >= 3 (known_dest excludes unknown/unk/none/null/n-a/?/- and unknown_*)
lanl.triage: investigate if R else (record_failed_attempt if current result Failure else continue_monitoring)
lanl.ambiguity_rule: older_history_summary.failed_attempts and known_failed_destination_computers only bound ambiguous cases; pairs require old_fails==0 and unknown_destination_failed_events==0 so both arms stay evaluable
lanl.note: Fail->Failure explicit mapping per A427 v2

oracles.dual_implementation_requirement: Primary script and an independently written second-path verifier must recompute Gold for EVERY arm of EVERY pair and control from the scene state alone; 100% agreement required. Any disagreement => STOP_GOLD_DISAGREEMENT.

baseline_eligibility: count_distinct_known_failed_destinations<=2 and equals distinct known failed dests among visible failure events
recent_prior_events seconds_before_current values pairwise distinct (no same-second collisions)
pair_families.edit: Append ONE prior event: exact schema copy of an existing failed LogOn (same authentication_type, destination_account, destination_computer as an EXISTING known failed destination, logon_type, orientation='LogOn', result='Fail'), seconds_before_current = deterministic unused in-window value: from candidates {t in 1..300 : t not in used_seconds}, pick the value minimizing |t - median(existing failed seconds)|, tie -> smaller; insert into recent_prior_events preserving its existing ordering convention (descending seconds_before_current); all other fields byte-identical
pair_families.registered_monotonicity_expectation: Risk escalation only. Model action distribution must move toward or stay at investigate; any margin movement toward the old action (de-escalation) is a monotonicity-violation candidate. Primary endpoint: strict per-arm action correctness vs oracle Gold.

baseline_eligibility: exists v in validator_set with zero valid votes at candidate_round
pair_families.edit: Append ONE message {author: chosen fresh non-voting validator (deterministic: lowest-index validator_set member with zero valid votes), block: candidate_block, kind: 'vote', round: candidate_round, received: max(existing received)}; append at end of received_messages preserving non-decreasing received order; all other fields byte-identical
pair_families.registered_monotonicity_expectation: Rejection-related margin must not increase; accept/wait margin must not move toward wait. Primary endpoint: strict per-arm action correctness.

baseline_eligibility: stratum C=0 with len(support)>=1 (Q may be 0 or 1; Gold wait or accept)
exists observed block b' != candidate_block in received_messages (any kind)
pair_families.edit: Append ONE message {author: existing candidate supporter (deterministic: lowest-index supporter by validator_set order), block: b' (deterministic: lowest block id != candidate_block among observed blocks), kind: 'vote', round: candidate_round, received: max(existing received)}; all other fields byte-identical
pair_families.registered_monotonicity_expectation: Acceptance-related margin must not increase; evidence-driven escalation toward reject only. Primary endpoint: strict per-arm action correctness.

baseline_eligibility: exists v in validator_set with zero valid votes at candidate_round (fresh voter)
pair_families.edit: Append ONE valid vote for candidate_block from the fresh voter (same deterministic rules as T1); all other fields byte-identical
pair_families.new_gold: reject_conflict (C stays 1; stability under additional legal votes)
pair_families.registered_monotonicity_expectation: Rejection must not be undone by additional legal votes; accept-margin increase is a violation candidate.

excluded_axes_with_reason.reason: Design census found 0 DEV scenes with exactly 2 known failed destinations AND a third destination present in-scene; fabricating an unattested computer alias would violate the known-destination semantics and the A461 audit's provenance requirements. Axis recorded infeasible; S-crossing is covered only inside the S=true stratum of stability controls.

negative_controls.design: Per pair family, same-shape append with provably zero Gold effect: Twins-T1 -> vote by author NOT in validator_set; Twins-T2 -> vote for b' by a NON-supporter valid author; Twins-T3 -> kind='proposal' message; LANL-L1 -> SUCCESS LogOn to the same destination. Dual-oracle must confirm old_gold==new_gold on the control arm.
negative_controls.purpose: Format/length-matched contrast: margin movement on neutral appends bounds generic serialization effects (G-1 alternative explanation 1).

negative_controls.design: Within each LANL-L1 pair scene (and a Twins analog on received timestamps where feasible), retime EXISTING prior events to other unused in-window values preserving ordering and digit width where possible; event count, destinations, results, and Gold all unchanged. Dual-oracle confirms Gold invariance on both arms.
negative_controls.purpose: Directly preregisters the A428_021-vs-024 clue (parallel-session analysis 5fb35e9) as a control axis; time-value changes with Gold invariance must not produce strict action errors beyond the format baseline.

negative_controls.design: Render every arm (pairs + controls) through the pinned native Kev renderer (SystemOneRequest -> to_record -> encode(strict=True), max 8192) with CPU tokenizer only; record per-arm token counts, token-id SHA256, first-difference index vs baseline arm, and digit-width of edited numeric fields.
negative_controls.purpose: No unmatched-pair claims: token-count deltas are reported per pair as measured confounds (same character width does NOT imply same token count; 5fb35e9). Any arm exceeding max length => STOP_TOKEN_TRUNCATION.

pair_budget.target_pairs_per_family_group: LANL-L1: up to 4 pairs per day group (day:48/49/50); Twins-T1/T2/T3: up to 8/8/6 pairs from distinct run groups where available
pair_budget.hard_cap: Total frozen pair+control rows must keep a future paired GPU pilot <= 128 native forwards (2 arms per row)
pair_budget.determinism: All selections (scene, author, block, seconds value) use the deterministic rules above with stable sort; no randomness, no model or tokenizer consultation during pair construction

stop_conditions: STOP_NO_RULE_PRESERVING_PAIR: zero surviving pairs in a family after all gates
STOP_FEWER_THAN_TWO_INDEPENDENT_FAMILIES: less than two source families with surviving pairs
STOP_GOLD_DISAGREEMENT: primary and independent oracle disagree on any arm
STOP_GOLD_MISMATCH_WITH_ARCHIVED: recomputed baseline Gold contradicts archived A427/A430 oracle values for the same scenes
STOP_TOKEN_TRUNCATION: any rendered arm exceeds native max length or renderer strict mode fails
STOP_ONLY_GENERIC_NUMERIC_FORMAT_SENSITIVITY: reserved for G2 interpretation of control vs pair contrasts (5fb35e9)
primary_metrics_registered_before_gpu: strict policy-action correctness per arm vs dual-oracle Gold, reported per family and source group (never merged across families)

pairwise monotonicity violation: strict action error whose direction is non-monotone under the registered expectation (e.g., de-escalation after adding failure evidence; accept-margin increase after conflict evidence)
per-pair signed action margin deltas (secondary; margin changes alone never constitute a security claim)
negative-control contrast: violation/error rates on N1/N2 arms vs policy-relevant arms, per family
distance-to-threshold stratification (LANL: failures 4 vs >=5; Twins: support count vs quorum)
interpretation_boundaries: Endpoint is model policy consistency under oracle-validated source-local rules; NOT a deployed-authorization vulnerability and NOT an attack success claim
SecJev typed questions are independent causal rows; cross-question prediction agreement is not information-flow evidence (SecJev v2 3.1; A451 recount)
No TEST/CAL rows at any stage; DEV scenes only; no tuning on any heldout
Mechanism (Q/K/LoRA) claims require a separate protocol, confirmed behavioral positives excluding N1/N2 explanations, and separate GPU approval
